items.question: Which deities must be worshipped outside the preceding ritual enclosure?
premises: The ritual instruction continues to the area outside that enclosure.
The Vasu forms are specified as objects of worship there.
Deities beginning with Indra are specified as objects of worship there.
items.inference: Outside that enclosure one should worship the Vasu forms and the deities led by Indra.
uncertainties: The precise spatial referent of tad in tadbahir depends on the immediately preceding ritual context.
items.plain_english: Outside of that, one should worship the Vasu forms and, further outside, the deities beginning with Indra.
